Prepare, wait for the organization's turn, then admit under the row lock.

`X-Celesto-Client` (ui, sdk, cli or mcp) records which surface made the
sandbox; without it the credential type decides (see resolve_rest_origin).

The wait for the turn holds no pooled connection, so a burst from one
organization cannot empty the pool for everyone else. The sandbox-created
alert goes to the broker after the response is sent, so neither the
organization's turn nor the client waits on it.

CustomTemplateLogsResponse.title: CustomTemplateLogsResponse
CustomTemplateLogsResponse.description:
The end of the latest build's log.

``log`` is empty until the build worker has copied the first bytes.
It holds at most the last 256 KB: ``offset`` is the byte position in the
whole log where ``log`` starts, and ``truncated`` is True when earlier
bytes were left out. ``size`` is how many log bytes are stored; send it
back as ``known_size`` and, while it has not changed, the answer is
``unchanged: true`` with an empty ``log`` (keep showing the last one).
